async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Select the project 'Primer / design' from the expanded menu
    await page.get_by_role("menu", name="Select project to create milestone").get_by_role("menuitem", name="Primer / design").click()
    # Wait for navigation to the project's milestones page
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click the button to create a new milestone for the selected project
    # Assuming the button is named 'New milestone' or similar
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="New milestone").click()
    # Wait for the form to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Fill in the milestone details
    # Fill the title
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title").fill("Product Launch Event")
    # Fill the start date
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Start date").fill("2023-01-16")
    # Fill the due date
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date").fill("2023-01-30")
    
    # Step 4: Submit the form to create the milestone
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Create milestone").click()
    # Wait for the milestone to be created and the page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Since the task is to create the milestone, and I've performed the actions, I'll terminate.
    # The task doesn't specify what to return, so I'll assume a success message.
    return "Milestone created successfully for Product Launch Event from 2023-01-16 to 2023-01-30."
